title: Monotonicity of the Gaussian profile
statement: Let $U(\alpha)=\varphi(Q(\alpha))$ be the Gaussian isoperimetric profile, where $Q$ is the lower standard Gaussian quantile and $\varphi$ is the standard Gaussian density. If $a,b\in(0,1)$, $a\le b$, and $a+b\le1$, then $U(a)\le U(b)$.
replaced: Let $\Phi$ and $\varphi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function and density, and put $Q=\Phi^{-1}$ and $I(p)=\varphi(Q(p))$ for $0<p<1$. If $a,b\in(0,1)$, $a\le b$, and $a+b\le1$, then $I(a)\le I(b)$.
